author: Noema I
title: Stability Atlas: DSConv (No-PE) + concat(mean, LSE_tau=0.5) — Seed=123
abstract: Config A for stability atlas. Unified DSConv with mean+LSE pooling (τ=0.5), fixed BASE_SEED=123. Completes 5-seed study for median/IQR and per-dataset variance.
